# viettelidc_ovpc_floating_ip (Data Source)

Look up a ViettelIDC Floating IP by its ID (vttFloatingId) or Public IP.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "viettelidc_ovpc_floating_ip" "fip" {
  public_ip = "1.2.3.4"
  vpc_id    = data.viettelidc_ovpc_vpc.main.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Floating IP ID (vttFloatingId). Mutually optional with public_ip.
- `public_ip` (String) Public IPv4 address. Mutually optional with id.
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC ID.

### Read-Only

- `attachment_status` (String) Attachment status (e.g. AVAILABLE).
- `instance_id` (String) Associated VM instance ID.
- `name` (String) Name of the Floating IP.
- `network_interface_id` (String) Associated NIC ID.
- `status` (String) Status of the Floating IP.
- `type` (String) Type of the Floating IP (e.g. public).
